description:
## Goal

Make every fixed core type and built-in opaque a retained handle in `Types`, so common constructors such as `int()`, `atom()`, `empty_list()`, `map_top()`, and `pid()` return directly without rebuilding, hashing, or searching a descriptor.

## Strategy

Extend the existing lattice-constant ownership into one explicit immutable core-type inventory constructed at world creation. Route only descriptors with no operand through it; leave unary and structural constructors for a separate direct-edge design. Prove both the type identities and zero boundary work under TDD.

## Acceptance

Focused type and fixture-canary tests, full-arena canonical gate, format, check, strict Clippy, and full workspace tests pass. No generic result cache or second interning authority is added.
title: Retain fixed Ty constructors as world constants
